Package aor.proj3t.entities

Class Evaluation

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.entities.Evaluation
@Entity public class Evaluation extends Object
Entity representing an evaluation of a user within an evaluation cycle. An evaluation captures the performance assessment of an employee by their evaluator, including a scale rating, feedback, and status tracking.
